content: HBS BattleTech: SimGameState (strategy) builds a Contract; combat writes a CompletedContract; SimGameState.Update polls for CompletedContract and, when the interrupt queue is not open, calls ResolveCompleteContract(), which applies salvage (AddMechPart, Item.MECHPART/Item.MechDef stats), funds, pilot injuries, mech damage into the repair queue. Mods (SalvageOperations, IRTweaks) Harmony-patch ResolveCompleteContract, AddMechPart, BuildSimGameStatsResults. Pattern: tactical layer returns a result record; strategy layer applies it as one resolve step. Confirmed by search + SalvageOperations source.
